capabilities: Validate OKF bundle structure, frontmatter and links
Check trust, lifecycle and provenance fields
Fix safe missing fields and migrate legacy fields
Generate and refresh folder index.md listings
Report findings in a side panel and status bar
extras: Manifest says OKF v0.1 while the README targets v0.3 with v0.1/v0.2 compatibility. The optional Portent layer is beta (spec pre-1.0). Checks are read-only; fixes and migrations run only via explicit commands. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+.
problem: Obsidian does not check that notes follow the Open Knowledge Format, so required type frontmatter, index.md/log.md structure and trust fields can silently drift.
summary: Validator enforcing the Open Knowledge Format spec in a vault: frontmatter types, index.md/log.md structure, links, trust fields, plus fixes and reports.
